On Windows, MaiCord 0.5.x through 0.8.1 install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes. On Linux, the installer and tarball installs and the AppImage update from Settings > Updates, packages through your package manager, and the musl AppImage through AppImageUpdate.

### What's new

- **Server Hub.** A server's Server Hub opens as a page in place of the chat, as in Discord's client: the banner card with the server's members and boosts, Most Game Time with the top five players and their games, and Popular Games. Open it from the top of the channel list.
- **Channels & Roles.** A server with onboarding shows Channels & Roles at the top of its channel list. Customize asks the server's questions that give roles and channels. Browse Channels lists every channel by category, and you can follow or unfollow a channel or a whole category. MaiCord sends the changes together, as Discord's client does.
- **Display name styles.** Names show their role gradient, and in a server with enhanced role colours, so do role mentions, replies and compact names. A gradient moves and glows while the pointer is on a name. Name fonts and effects show where Discord's client shows them. Turn them off in Settings > Accessibility > Display Name Styles. Name font 17 draws in Teko, an open font.
- **Connection status.** The title bar shows when MaiCord is connecting, when it lost the connection (with the time to the next try) and when a connection failed. It shows Connected for 2 seconds when the connection comes back.
- **Voice sounds.** MaiCord plays a sound when you join or leave a voice channel, when someone else joins or leaves, and when the connection drops. Settings > Voice & Video > Sounds has a switch and a volume for them. The sounds are MaiCord's own.
- **Voice channels.** A voice channel shows its user limit. With Move Members, the voice member menu has Disconnect. The incoming call prompt has join and decline icons.
- **The window remembers its place.** MaiCord opens at the size and place where you closed it, maximized if it was. On Linux it keeps the size and the maximized state; Wayland doesn't let a program choose its place.
- **Linux windows.** You can resize the window from its edges and corners. The tray icon brings the window to the front. Logging out of KDE Plasma closes MaiCord instead of leaving it in the tray.
- **Your status.** Your own status shows on your profile and your member list row. With no status saved, MaiCord sets Idle as Discord's client does.
- **Video in calls.** A camera or stream your computer can't decode shows a notice instead of an empty tile. MaiCord asks for the codecs in the order the call announces them and stops asking for H.265 after its decoder fails.

### Fixed in this release

- **Friend requests.** Accept and Ignore on the Friends page did nothing when the list changed between the press and the release of the button. They work now, and a row no longer scrolls when you press it. (#18)
- **No voice audio on Linux.** With PipeWire set to a large audio quantum (1024 or 2048 frames), a voice channel showed Connected but stayed silent: MaiCord wrote at most 20 ms of audio each time the sound server asked, so the stream fell behind. It now writes all that the server asks for, and so do notification sounds. (#19)
- **Your profile showed Invisible.** Opened from a DM, your own profile showed you as Invisible, and an account that never chose a status showed none in the account menu. Both show the status MaiCord publishes now. (#20)
- **Copy Text froze MaiCord on Linux.** On KDE Plasma the window could stop for seconds when you copied text. MaiCord now hands the text to the clipboard from its event loop. (#22)
- **Spoilers in About Me.** In the profile panel beside a DM, a spoiler in a bio showed as a block in the text colour, its emoji drew on top, and a click did not reveal it. Spoilers now look and reveal as in chat, and emoji in a hidden spoiler stay hidden, in bios and in messages. (#28)
- **Large friend lists.** A friend list of about 600 or more friends, requests and blocked users failed to load ("Something went wrong"). It loads now. With thousands of them, some showed as "Unknown user" without an avatar and could not be found in search. MaiCord now keeps them all; 6,000 resolve.
- **Channels with long messages.** A history page or a pins page of long messages with embeds failed to load, so the channel stayed empty. They load now, and so does a server invite list of up to 1,000 invites.
- **One bad message no longer blanks the chat.** A message that failed to lay out or measure stopped the other messages from drawing. A mention with the ID 0 made a whole message show as raw Markdown.
- **Unknown mentions** of users, roles, channels, games and commands show as Discord's client shows them. Edits and pinned messages now keep the users they mention.
- **Spoken notifications** say "X replied to Y" for a reply, as Discord's client does.
- **Two-factor setup** shows the key for manual entry under the QR code.
- **Upload menu.** "Retry failed uploads" no longer sends again a file that Discord refused as too large.
- **Server pictures.** Interlaced PNG icons, banners, emoji and stickers, and PNGs with many data chunks, failed to crop and resize.
- **Plugin, theme and effect installs** from a link or a file now say why they failed.
- **Bold CFF and CFF2 fonts.** Bold text in a CFF or CFF2 font without a bold face drew at the regular weight. MaiCord now emboldens these outlines as DirectWrite does: each point, curve control points included, lands within 0.0001 design units of DirectWrite's, and the glyphs widen as bold TrueType glyphs do.
- **Fonts.** Text in a fallback font that fails now draws its missing glyphs instead of nothing, and bold text falls back to the regular weight when the bold face fails. On Linux, GNU Unifont reads as it does in other programs.
…

On Windows, MaiCord 0.5.x through 0.8.0 install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes. On Linux, the installer and tarball installs and the AppImage update from Settings > Updates, packages through your package manager, and the musl AppImage through AppImageUpdate. MaiCord now needs an Intel Haswell (2013) or AMD Excavator (2015) or Zen (2017) processor, or newer: on Intel, a 4th generation Core i3, i5 or i7 (i3/i5/i7-4xxx) or newer.

Please update soon: a message that any Discord user can send froze MaiCord 0.8.0 and earlier (the first fix below).

### What's new

- **YouTube sounds better.** MaiCord plays YouTube's Opus audio, which goes up to 20 kHz, as the YouTube Music web player does. Before, it played the AAC format, which stops at about 16 kHz. A video with no Opus format plays AAC as before.
- **YouTube loudness.** Loud videos and tracks play at the loudness of YouTube's and YouTube Music's web players. Peaks are no longer cut off before your system volume.
- **YouTube Music art tracks play as audio.** A track with one still picture no longer downloads and decodes its video: the example track took 2.0 MB, not 5.6 MB. Audio-only tracks show a sharp 1280x720 picture instead of a stretched small one.
- **YouTube format picks.** The media page header shows the format MaiCord picked. Portrait videos no longer play at 480p. Of two formats of one size, the higher frame rate wins. A format of 4 GiB or more no longer makes the video fail.
- **Videos without a decoder say so.** A video that your computer has no decoder for showed an empty grey box. It now says why, and MaiCord stops downloading it again every minute. On Linux, H.264 video without a GPU decoder needs OpenH264: the box says "Install OpenH264 to play this video".

### Fixed in this release

- **A Thai message froze MaiCord.** A Thai letter with 255 or more marks made text layout never finish, so the window stopped responding. Any Discord user could send such a message. It lays out now.
- **Linux on Wayland, KDE Plasma and NixOS.** (thanks to @Tricked-dev for reporting this)
  - Paste, copy, drag and drop, and input methods did not work on any Wayland desktop. The window icon and the window's handle for the desktop's dialogs failed too. All of them work now.
  - MaiCord did not start when the desktop had only some variable fonts, such as Noto Sans on NixOS or Ubuntu Sans. A broken font file could stop all text too. MaiCord now skips such a file.
  - Chinese, Japanese and Korean text showed as boxes on NixOS and Fedora, whose Noto Sans CJK is a CFF2 font. MaiCord reads it now. While the boxes showed, each look-up of the missing font took 4 to 6 ms. So the client got very slow. MaiCord now remembers a font it can't use.
  - On GNOME 48 and later, the interface used a fallback font instead of Adwaita Sans. It uses the desktop's font now.
  - Close to the tray left the window on screen, where it looked frozen. It hides now, and on KDE the taskbar shows MaiCord's icon again when the window comes back.
  - When the GPU could not start, Linux asked for Direct3D 11. It now names what it needs: OpenGL ES 3.1.
- **YouTube and other media audio on Linux.**
  - Audio skipped after the stream ran dry, for example while a download waited for the network. It now pauses and plays all of the audio.
  - With a sound server of long latency, the audio could go silent after about 2 seconds. MaiCord now queues enough audio for such a server.
  - A sound server that doesn't answer gets two more tries, 1 and 2 seconds later, while the player shows buffering. After that the player says "Sound server not answering".
  - Some AAC audio decoded with small errors.
- **YouTube Music links.** A music.youtube.com link to one track played as a YouTube video, at YouTube's lower loudness. It plays as YouTube Music now: a song with one picture plays as audio only, at the loudness of the web player.
- **Devanagari and Bengali digits.** On Windows, a message with Devanagari or Bengali digits, such as "४६", failed to lay out. Segoe UI has the digits but not the script. The chat's text could fail to draw with it. Both work now.
- **Copy and cut on the sign-in screen.** Ctrl+C and Ctrl+X now work in the login field. A password, and a sign-in link the field hides, are never copied.
- **Long runs of joiners.** A letter followed by thousands of zero-width joiners stalled the window. One Bengali line took 579 ms for each layout, and Khmer, Myanmar, Sinhala and Tibetan were slow too. Such a line now takes one pass.
- **Heavy animated stickers.** A small crafted Lottie sticker could keep the sticker decoder busy for seconds on each frame. A frame now stops at a work limit that is more than 9 times the largest frame of Discord's own sticker packs.
- **Keybinds in a call.** With the window in the background, a short press of a custom keybind, such as toggle mute, often did nothing. MaiCord now reads the keys every 20 ms.
- Streams and cameras in a call kept decoding while the window was hidden in the tray. They stop now, as they do when the window is minimized. Call audio doesn't change.
- With the Prism name effect (five colours), the profile editor failed to draw and the client kept one processor core busy. The row takes five colours now, and a frame that fails is retried at most four times a second.
- A theme that MaiCord saved could fail to load again when an effect setting's name had a control character in it.
- The chat no longer fades out above the message box while it is scrolled up. Discord's client has no such fade. With a flat theme and a background effect or Stars, the fade showed as a dark band.

### Faster and smaller

- The Windows MaiCord.exe is 6.48 MB and the Linux program 6.49 MB, both under 6.5 MB.
- No change in this release made a measured path more than 2% slower, and most measured paths are 5 to 90% faster.
…

On Windows, MaiCord 0.5.x through 0.7.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes. On Linux, the installer and tarball installs and the AppImage update from Settings > Updates, packages through your package manager, and the musl AppImage through AppImageUpdate.

### What's new

- **Go Live: share your screen.** Stream a screen or a window, with its sound, from the voice card or the call bar, and watch others' streams as before.
  - Encoded on your GPU and end-to-end encrypted, at Discord's resolutions and frame rates up to your Nitro's or the server's boost tier. Turn on "Unlock all qualities" in the stream options to pick any of them, 1440p 60 fps included (off by default; only clients check these limits).
  - Stream modes (smoother video, clearer text, custom), mute stream audio, hide the preview, your own tile with its viewer list, and a stream menu to change the source or quality while live.
  - Light on the machine: nothing is encoded until someone watches, and a watched 1440p60 AV1 stream took about 12% of an AMD GPU's video engine in our tests, against 16% for the official client on the same settings.
  - On Windows, pick an application or a whole screen; on Linux, the desktop's share dialog opens. Sharing sound needs Windows 10 version 2004 or later, or PipeWire with xdg-desktop-portal on Linux. MaiCord's own sound is never shared.
- **Tabs in the title bar.** Turn them on in Settings > Appearance > Layout > "Show tabs in the title bar".
  - Pin channels and DMs with "+", Ctrl+T, a middle-click or "Open in new tab". Ctrl+Tab switches, Ctrl+W closes, Ctrl+1 to 9 jump; drag to reorder. An unread channel's tab shows a dot, and tabs come back after a restart.
  - "Open in new tab" on a picture, GIF, video, audio file or voice message gives it a page of its own. Videos and tracks keep playing while you work in another tab; a playlist gets a queue with thumbnails beside the player. Tabs and pages follow your theme, gradients included.
- **Account and server settings.** My Account (username, e-mail, phone, password, authenticator app, SMS, backup codes, security keys, disable and delete), Devices, Data and Privacy, Connected Apps, and blocked and ignored lists.
  - Servers gain a banner upload, Server Tag, Server Template, join applications, Enable Community and Integrations (command permissions, AutoMod, webhooks).
  - Accessibility follows Discord's: a live preview, UI density, chat text size, zoom (Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0), saturation, role colour dots, underlined links and reduced motion. Streamer Mode hides invites and personal information, has a keybind, can switch on while OBS or XSplit runs, and on Windows keeps the window out of screen captures. Settings > Keybinds lists your custom keybinds.
- **Profiles, friends and Home**, laid out like Discord's: Board, Activity, Mutual Friends and Mutual Servers, connected accounts, a "Find or start a conversation" bar, Online, All, Pending and Add Friend, and Message Requests.
- **Chat.**
  - Select text across messages: a drag runs on over other messages and authors, scrolling the chat at the edges, and Ctrl+C copies them in order.
  - Type `@game` to mention a game; it shows as a chip and opens the game's profile.
  - Animated WebP images, like an X post's "GIF", get the favourite star, and favourites are saved as the official client saves them.
  - The free upload limit is 20 MiB, and Discord, not MaiCord, decides when a file is too large.
- **Voice.** Voice, stream audio, voice messages and the soundboard run on MaiCord's own Opus encoder and decoder: 26 to 32% less encoding time and 13 to 26% less decoding time than before, the same output on Windows and Linux, and it passes the Opus conformance vectors.

### Faster and smaller

- The Windows MaiCord.exe is 6.46 MB and the Linux program 6.47 MB, both under 6.5 MB with all of the above.
- The emoji picker scrolls on about a third of the GPU time (7 to 10% down to about 3% at 1440p), with no frame over 16.7 ms. Text rasterizes in 20% less GPU time, and WebM (VP8) video decodes in up to 27% less.
- Scrolling, switching channels and the member list use the same main-thread CPU time as 0.7.0 or less; deciding what to redraw takes 29% less time, and nothing wakes while the window is hidden.

### Fixed in this release

- A channel whose loaded messages didn't fill the window, such as a welcome channel of join messages, never loaded older ones, because there was nothing to scroll. MaiCord now loads older messages until the window is full, and the mouse wheel at the top always asks for more.
- A server could turn into a blank, unavailable icon if MaiCord received it while you were in one of its voice channels; it loads now.
- A 1440p stream or camera showed black in a large call tile; it shows at full size now.
- With a gradient theme, the taskbar and tray icon was Discord's blurple; it takes the theme's accent now.
- Some WebP avatars showed as a grey circle, and some GIFs failed to play; both work now.
- Moving the pointer over and off GIFs no longer cancels and resends the favourites download each time.
- Emoji suggestions after ":" rank by your use from the first message. Mention pills centre on their text.
- Screen readers get a heading and status on every sign-in screen.
- A crash when adding members to an integration, and settings text that could vanish after a failed rebuild.

### Removed

- Spotify sign-in (it saved a login nothing used); a saved one is deleted at startup. Spotify embeds, activity links and the profile connection are unchanged.

### Features

- Show 1440p call video at full size
- Add an option to stream at any Go Live quality
- Show tabs and the Silk Waves theme in the README hero
- Add opt-in channel tabs to the title bar
- Add the Wayland runs of the new pages against the fake Discord
- Add Go Live, account and server settings pages and profile parity
…

On Windows, MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes. New to Linux? See Install.

### Highlights

- **MaiCord for Linux.** The same client now runs on Linux: x86-64, a Wayland desktop and Linux 6.1 or newer.
  - Install it with the one-line `install.sh`, an AppImage, a tarball, or the signed apt, dnf and pacman repositories. The `.deb`, `.rpm` and Arch packages are attached too, and Alpine and Void use the `-musl` builds. The commands are in the README.
  - The packages accept OpenSSL 3 or 4, so they install on Fedora 45 and other systems that moved to OpenSSL 4.
  - It has the Windows client's features: chat, voice and video, the plugin, theme and effect catalog, notifications, a tray icon, saved accounts, security keys and screen reader support. Windows Hello, the Windows notification page and the echo and noise reduction switch exist on Windows only.
  - The installer and tarball installs, and the AppImage, update from Settings > Updates. Packages update through your package manager, and the musl AppImage through AppImageUpdate.
  - The program is 6.34 MB. The tarball is 5.3 MB and the AppImage 5.9 MB.
- **Plugins and effects on Linux.** Plugins load as `.so` files and effects carry GLSL, from the same source as the Windows files. A catalog plugin appears on Linux once its Linux build is published, and each new version has one.
- **Faster WebP images.** Avatars, emoji and other lossy WebP images decode in a third to a half of the GPU time they took: two dispatches per image instead of up to 28, with identical pixels. On Linux, a GPU that cannot run the decode (fewer than 512 compute invocations per group) decodes them on the CPU.
  - The transparency of animated emoji and GIF picker previews decodes in a fifth to under half of the CPU time it took, and lossless WebP images in about three quarters, with identical pixels.
- **Text.** Lines now wrap by Unicode's line-breaking rules (UAX #14, Unicode 17).
  - Indic scripts, Khmer, Myanmar, Sinhala and Tibetan, as well as Arabic, Hebrew and emoji, are now shaped the way HarfBuzz shapes them. Hangul jamo combine into syllables.
- **Performance.** The main thread uses about the same CPU time as before, or less.
  - Large JPEGs and video frames take less GPU time to draw, with identical pixels.
  - Plugins load with fewer system calls and receive events in about a quarter fewer cycles.
  - Image decoding takes memory as it needs it: it starts at 352 KB instead of 21.3 MB.
- **Windows.** No Windows features change, and MaiCord.exe is smaller: 6.25 MB, down from 6.49 MB. MaiCord now identifies as the current Discord desktop client.
  - MaiCord 0.7.0 requires Windows 10 version 1809 or later, or Windows 11, and a WDDM 2.0 or newer graphics driver (one with Direct3D 11 fences). Every GPU MaiCord runs on has one from its maker; a PC still on an older driver is asked to update it at startup.
- **For developers.** `maicord-plugin build --target linux` builds a plugin's `.so`, and `maicord-plugin effect build --glsl yes --dxbc-from` adds an effect's GLSL. See the SDK and effects guides.
  - A plugin built with this SDK has about a third less code from the same source, on Windows and Linux, and the same descriptor, so nothing else changes for it; a Linux `.so` no longer carries a symbol table.
- **Fixes.**
  - On some Intel graphics (reported on UHD Graphics 630), text lost parts of its letters or filled them in: an L without its bottom bar, an n without its right stem, a d drawn as a solid block. Every letter now reaches the GPU as a closed outline, and text draws the same as on other GPUs.
  - The first click in the sign-in form's e-mail or password field could place no caret; it does now.
  - Pressing Ctrl+A in the profile bio, or another multi-line settings field, with a blank line in it froze the window; the whole text now selects.
  - On Windows, the window menu and the tray menu now open dark under a dark theme; they stayed light.
  - Clicking a notification no longer un-maximises a maximised window.
  - When a long word was broken to fit a line, the letters either side of the break kept the kerning they had as a pair, so an A before a wrapped V sat too close. Each side of the break is now spaced on its own.
  - On Linux, some images shown after a video had played could draw slanted or garbled; they now draw correctly.
  - A crash when the catalog refreshed while an item's page was open in Plugins, Themes or Effects.
  - Allowing a plugin while the catalog refreshed installs exactly the build its dialog showed; if the catalog changed that build meanwhile, nothing installs and MaiCord asks again about the new one.
  - Settings > Effects > Installed now lists an effect file in the effects folder that the catalog also lists but has no install record for, instead of leaving it out of the list and its count.
  - With `maicord-plugin effect preview --day-seconds`, the effect and a theme with variants now pass a whole day in that many seconds; before, they moved only when the preview options changed.
  - Opening Settings on an effect's page no longer shows what is behind the window through the effect preview for its first frames; the preview fades in with the panel.

### Features

- Show the 0.7.0 size on the banner
- Show the 0.7.0 size on the social card
- Show "(edited)" after edited messages
- Show the full profile of members without visible roles
- Show a demo author in the README's plugin screenshot
- Show MaiCord in the README
- Add a chat list benchmark
- Add Linux crypto, GLES and Wayland backends

### Fixes

- Note the crash, consent, preview and effect clock fixes
- Run GPU hang reproductions on WARP and fix the benchmark's call markers
- Keep the session up on media failures and fix the tiled atlas hang
- Restore includes the probe builds need and fix opt-in targets
…

MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Smoother changes.** Switching themes, and a time-of-day theme moving between day and night, now glide smoothly, frame by frame. Effect knobs ease to their new values too. Reduced motion keeps every change instant.
- **The Friends page follows your theme.** Its column shows the background effect and gradient like the chat does, with the same tabs and search field as the Inbox.
- **Silk Waves 1.3.1 in the catalog.** Its month and day/night changes ease over about a second, and the Glare knob now does something: 0 turns the glow off and higher values make the ribbon's bright folds bloom, at night too.
- **Smooth scrolling in Plugins, Themes and Effects.** These pages now ease like the rest of Settings when you use the wheel, touchpad or paging keys.
- **Fixes.**
  - A crash when going back to Settings > Updates after visiting Plugins, Themes or Effects.
  - The title bar no longer flickers when switching Settings pages.
  - Ctrl image zoom no longer works on a message image hidden behind Settings, a popup or a panel.
  - A development copy of an effect that the catalog also lists now opens its own page and knobs.

### Other

- Scroll the store pages through the shared scroll animator
- Clear the Updates rows when the page frees their text
- Stop Settings page switches flashing the caption bar
- Start the image zoom only over an uncovered message image
- Theme the Friends page like the chat view
- List development effects beside catalog items with the same slug
- Glide theme and knob changes once per frame

MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **The Silk Waves theme follows the effect's knobs.** While Silk Waves is your background, a month or Day or Night picked on its knob page holds the theme on that month or phase too, with the same smooth change.
- **Knob choices that fit.** A choice on an effect's knob page shows as buttons sized to their labels while they fit, and as a dropdown when the window is too narrow. Silk Waves' choices are shorter: Clock, Night when dark, Day and Night.
- **Fixes.**
  - "Show spoiler content" in Settings no longer overlaps in narrow windows; its third option is now "Moderated".

### Other

- Let themes follow their effect's knobs and fit knob choices

MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Themes that follow the time of day.** A theme can now change with the clock and the month, and switch between light and dark on its own; the change fades in smoothly.
- **Silk Waves theme.** A new theme in Settings > Themes to pair with the Silk Waves effect: dark at night and in the early morning, light through the day, coloured from the same month palettes as the sky.
- **Readable Silk Waves on dark themes.** With "Follow the clock", Silk Waves keeps its night sky whenever MaiCord or Windows is dark, so text over it stays readable. The day-only option is now labelled for light themes.
- **Catalog.** MaiCord reads a newer catalog index that can list items needing future versions as "Needs a newer MaiCord" instead of hiding them.

### Other

- Give the showcase's /release reply a newer ID than the GIF before it
- Let themes change with the time of day and month
- Read a forward-compatible catalog index

MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Silk Waves.** A new background effect in Settings > Effects: a ribbon of light over a month-tinted sky with drifting glitter, inspired by the PS3 menu background. It follows the time of day and your light or dark appearance.
- **Effects on light themes.** Background effects no longer vanish on light themes: their light turns into soft shade, keeping its colours, and switching themes cross-fades. Turn it off globally or per effect under "Light themes".
- **Faster effects.** Aurora, Bokeh, Plasma, Starfield and Wave lines use 15–83 % less GPU time and look the same.
- **More capable effects.** Effects can follow the clock and the light or dark appearance, and draw in several passes with meshes, particles and state that carries between frames. The effect guide covers both.
- **Attachment size in errors.** A file over the upload limit now says how big it is, for example "video.mp4 is 27.3 MB, over the 10 MB limit."
- **Fixes.**
  - The status pill on an effect's live preview is readable over dark effects.
  - Effects that need a newer MaiCord show "Needs a newer MaiCord" instead of failing to install.

### Features

- Show the file's size when an attachment is over the limit

### Performance

- Speed up the sample effects

### Other

- Adapt effects to light themes and keep preview pills readable
- Read the full catalog index with effect interface levels
- Let effects declare pass graphs with targets, vertex grids and state
- Give effects opt-in clock and appearance inputs

MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.x install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Plugin cards look like real embeds.** Cards such as Translate's share the embed's surface and full-height accent bar, with actions like Hide as footer links. Hiding a card no longer leaves an empty gap under the message.
- **Messages only you can see show an eye icon.** Plugin messages and private bot replies read "Only you can see this • Dismiss message".
- **Live effect previews.** Every installed effect plays live on its page in Settings > Effects, not only the one you're using.
- **Plugin information dialogs.** Plugins can show read-only text in a dialog with a single Close button (plugin API level 3). Permissions Viewer and View Raw use it in their catalog updates.
- **Fixes.**
  - The Installing spinner animates and no longer covers the button's text.
  - Video, audio and poll labels such as "Playback unavailable" no longer show through the "You're viewing older messages" bar, and the unread banner's text no longer shows through the pinned, search and requests panels.
  - A plugin dialog with no button label shows OK, as documented.

### Features

- Add read-only text and info dialogs to the plugin API (level 3)

### Other

- Render plugin cards as embeds and collapse them when hidden
- Draw timeline media controls under the timeline overlays
- Preview every installed effect live on its detail page
- Animate store busy buttons and keep their spinner off the label

MaiCord 0.5.x and 0.6.0 install this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **One scrollbar everywhere.** Every list, panel and popup now uses the thin scrollbar from Settings, which widens when you point at it or drag it.
- **Leaner.** About 3,900 lines of code are gone, and the executable shrinks from 6.50 to 6.48 MB.
  - Animated text and nameplates no longer ask Windows for the animation setting every frame.
  - Opening a lossless WebP uses 32 KiB less memory.
- **Fixes.**
  - Changing an effect setting whose lowest and highest values are the same no longer produces an invalid value.
  - The Effects page's Performance defaults card shows your real settings.
  - Theme pages show their text contrast rating.
